title: agentlake / quality
description: Skeleton for the eval harness (Day 5). The cost and token panels run real SQL against agentlake.trace_events_rt and are empty only because nothing sets a prompt_version attribute yet. The eval-score panels are deliberately text, not charts: an observability platform does not get to fabricate its own quality numbers. See ADR-005 and ADR-003 #3.

panels.title: What is wired and what is not

options.content:
**Live now.** The two panels below run real SQL against `agentlake.trace_events_rt`, filtered on `attributes['prompt_version']`. They return no rows because nothing in the agent sets that attribute yet, not because they are stubbed. Emit one `prompt_version` attribute from `services/agent` and they populate with no dashboard change.

**Not yet.** Eval scores (pass rate, judge score, regression against a pinned suite) need the eval harness, which does not exist. Those panels are this text rather than a chart against a table that is not there: a dashboard that shows a plausible number it did not measure is the same failure `get_trace` and `query_metrics` refused to commit as honest stubs (ADR-003 #3), just rendered in colour.

panels.title: Cost per turn by prompt version
panels.description: trace_id is one turn (ADR-003 #4), so cost per turn is sum(cost_usd) over distinct trace_ids. Empty until something sets a prompt_version attribute.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval_ms(ts) AS time, attributes['prompt_version'] AS prompt_version, sum(cost_usd) / greatest(uniqExact(trace_id), 1) AS cost_per_turn_usd FROM agentlake.trace_events_rt WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(ts) AND attributes['prompt_version'] != '' GROUP BY time, prompt_version ORDER BY time

panels.title: Tokens per turn by prompt version

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval_ms(ts) AS time, attributes['prompt_version'] AS prompt_version, (sum(prompt_tokens) + sum(completion_tokens)) / greatest(uniqExact(trace_id), 1) AS tokens_per_turn FROM agentlake.trace_events_rt WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(ts) AND attributes['prompt_version'] != '' GROUP BY time, prompt_version ORDER BY time

panels.title: Turn cost distribution (all traffic)
panels.description: The one panel here with data today: per-turn cost and step count across every trace, whether or not it carries a prompt_version. It is what the two panels above will look like once they have a dimension to split on.

targets.rawSql: SELECT trace_id, sum(cost_usd) AS cost_usd, sum(prompt_tokens) + sum(completion_tokens) AS tokens, uniqExact(span_id) AS spans, countIf(status != 'ok') AS errors FROM agentlake.trace_events_rt WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(ts) GROUP BY trace_id ORDER BY cost_usd DESC LIMIT 20

options.content:
### Not measured yet

Needs the eval harness: a pinned question set, a scoring function, and a run id written back as spans.

When it exists this becomes a timeseries of pass rate by `prompt_version`, from the same table as every other panel here.

**Not** a chart of zeroes, and not a chart against a table that does not exist.

### Not measured yet

An LLM-judge score per turn, emitted as a span attribute so it lands in `trace_events_rt` alongside the cost it should be traded off against.

The interesting panel is score against `cost_per_turn_usd`, which is why that one is already live above.
